# ovirt_datacenter (Data Source)

The ovirt_datacenter data source returns the ID and details of a data center by its name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the data center. Either name or id must be specified.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the data center. Either name or id must be specified.
